notes:
A fix for chats failing on every brain.

- **No more "not valid JSON" or "exceeds the model's context length" from half an emoji.** An emoji is two pieces inside a string, and cutting text at a count can keep only the first one. When that half went to a provider, Claude refused the whole request ("unexpected end of hex escape") and NanoGPT's GLM said the prompt was too long. One of her memories of a Discord call held such a half, so every chat that recalled it failed, whatever the brain.
- **Every request is cleaned on the way out.** Chats, her inner life, her social replies, sections' agents and web searches drop any half emoji before they're sent, wherever it came from: a memory, an MCP server, a web page or a file.
- **Text is cut at whole characters.** Everywhere the app shortens text with "…", it now steps back rather than split an emoji.
